caption: The mean of $1$ and $2$, to 20 digits

mpmath.note: Each AGM step takes a square root, and the value depends on which. Choosing at every step the root with |a - g| <= |a + g| (the right choice) converges to -2.4621818911005727936 + 2.0983173530436351629i, which Wolfram 15 and ours give; taking the principal root at every step converges to 1.3110074646130093426 + 0.3724216751153703308i, which is mpmath agm (both measured at 25 digits).
julia.note: b = -10 lies on the branch cut of AGM(1, b) along the negative reals, and Julia (Arb) returns the limit from below, -2.4621818911005727936 - 2.0983173530436351629i: Wolfram 15 gives that value at -10 - 10^-12 i and ours (the limit from above) at -10 + 10^-12 i.
